claim: In a thundering herd, many clients make requests that need the same uncached downstream resource at about the same time, which sends many requests to the downstream dependency and can lead to throttling or brownout. The Builders' Library remedies this with request coalescing, where the servers or external cache ensure that only one pending request is out for uncached resources.

evidence.quote: One final consideration is the “thundering herd” situation, in which many clients make requests that need the same uncached downstream resource at approximately the same time. This can also occur when a server comes up and joins the fleet with an empty local cache.

This results in a large number of requests from each server going to the downstream dependency, which can lead to throttling/brownout. To remedy this issue we use request coalescing, where the servers or external cache ensure that only one pending request is out for uncached resources.
